identityKeyImpact.note: All six resolved movements attach to flight-number/direction identity keys already present from other source sections. Two exact Puducherry/Hyderabad counterpart variants are merged, giving a net increase of four accepted directed variants while the distinct candidate-key count remains unchanged.

jalandhar.basis: Official IndiGo directory states Adampur – AIP, Jalandhar City Airport; AAI eAIP GEN 2.4 lists ADAMPUR / VIAX.
jalandhar.sourceReuseQualification: Only factual airport-code identity is recorded as provenance; no airport-directory prose, imagery, or bulk data is reproduced.

pondicherry.note: AAI airport page confirms Puducherry Airport, and the existing catalog entry uniquely carries the Puducherry (Pondicherry) alias with PNY/VOPC; no new airport identity is added.
pondicherry.tenderReviewQualification: The user-provided AAI tender URL was not accessible to the web tool; its explicit PNY/VOPC crosswalk is recorded as user-supplied evidence, with the existing catalog as the resolved endpoint.

purnia.coordinateQualification: Unknown; an AAI airspace-circle center is not treated as an airport reference point.
purnia.note: Purnea spelling and Chunapur civil-enclave location corroborate existing PXN mapping; AAI eAIP identifies VEPU. PXN is absent from the reusable catalog so remains source-only; no coordinates are inferred.

renameNotice.reviewFinding: PIB's 31 January 2026 page is an advance notice that the PM would unveil the Adampur airport's new name on 1 February 2026. This page alone is not evidence the unveiling occurred; no airport-name change is applied here.

conflictReview.frequencyInterpretation: Conflict overlap dates are Indian local-calendar intersections derived from AAI's separate weekday convention for triage only; not DGCA-defined dates or UTC occurrences.

integration.minimumHonestPath: Add a DGCA-specific evidence-only schedule-record adapter (or a generic evidence schema extension) preserving raw designator, operator code/name, directional endpoints, raw frequency and clock values, effective dates, mapping basis, source URL/PDF SHA-256, unique page/station/row lineage, and variant conflicts. Keep carrier role unresolved, timezone null, actualOperationVerified false, and selectable false. The existing CAA shard may inform the evidence-only state shape but cannot be used as-is. Promote only after a schema/review decision; do not write these records into route runtime now. For Purnia, preserve PXN and cited ICAO VEPU as source evidence but mark PXN source-only because the pinned airport catalog has no PXN point; do not synthesize coordinates.
integration.reason: The accepted runtime OfficialService schema requires a two-character carrier, numeric-only flightNumber, and decoded daysOfWeek; this DGCA source keeps designator 6E separate from three-character operator code IGO and does not define a weekday legend or timezone. Mapping IGO to carrier fails the schema; mapping 6E to carrier would assert a carrier role not established by this source. The dated reference schemas require dated occurrences. The CAA evidence-shard schema demonstrates unresolved, non-selectable evidence fields, but is hard-bound to Taiwan CAA datasets and OGDL license metadata and is not reusable for DGCA.
integration.rightsQualification: Accurate reproduction with prominent DGCA attribution is supported by the captured Website Policy; no non-commercial-only restriction is present. Exclude any third-party content if later identified.

packetBaselineClassification.note: Packet-only classification before applying the separately cited airport-code supplement; source packet and parser outputs are unchanged.

runtimeComparison.routePairOverlapQualification: Context only; an ordered pair present under any carrier does not match the 6E flight designator, IGO operator code, schedule, or actual operation.

semantics.actualOperation: DGCA approved-schedule evidence only; actual operation is unverified.
semantics.airportCatalogEndpoints: Endpoint IATA values are evidence fields. A code absent from the pinned airport catalog is marked source-only-no-pinned-catalog-point; do not create coordinates or a runtime airport point from that code.
semantics.direction: One adjacent directed airport pair per source movement; no multi-stop itinerary chaining.
semantics.flightNumber: Preserve printed 6E designator and its digits; no integer normalization or operator-code equivalence inferred.
semantics.frequency: Raw DGCA string preserved; AAI 1=Monday through 7=Sunday is a separate corroborating annotation, not a DGCA legend.
semantics.operatorCode: IGO is preserved as the distinct DGCA Operator Code field.
semantics.time: Raw clock fields retained with unknown timezone; no UTC instants, dated occurrences, arrival-day offsets, or connections generated.
semantics.validity: Inclusive source effective dates classified as of 2026-10-07; expired rows remain in evidence but are not current/future candidates.

weekdayAnnotationSource.qualification: Corroborating annotation only. DGCA does not print a weekday legend; do not use this to create dated or UTC occurrences.
